description: Source code for Odoo module defining models and database views related to analytic planning, including classes for planning, planning lines, and statistical reports with database view initialization.

classes.name: report_account_analytic_planning
classes.description: Model representing an analytic planning with associated lines and statistics.

classes.name: report_account_analytic_planning_line
classes.description: Model representing individual lines within a planning, linked to analytic accounts and users.

classes.name: report_account_analytic_planning_stat_account
classes.description: Database view model summarizing planned and actual hours per analytic account.

classes.name: report_account_analytic_planning_stat
classes.description: Database view model summarizing planning statistics per user and account.

classes.name: report_account_analytic_planning_stat_user
classes.description: Database view model summarizing user-specific planning statistics.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of a planning record with reset statistics.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes database views for statistical reporting.
